docs.text: ❓ Frequently Asked Questions Q1. Can I use this app on macOS or Linux? Yes! It works on Windows, macOS, and Linux. Q2. How do I reset configuration? Delete .env and re-run the setup commands. Q3. How do I stop the app? Press Ctrl + C in the terminal. Q4. Where can I report bugs? Raise an issue on GitHub → Issues tab in your repository. 💬 For any feedback or suggestions, reach out to chaitramara@example.com

docs.text: 🩺 Troubleshooting Common issues and solutions during installation or setup. Issue Cause Solution npm not recognized Node.js not installed Install Node.js and restart terminal Port already in use Another app using port 3000 Change port in .env file Permission denied Missing admin rights Run terminal as Administrator Page not loading Server not running Run npm start 🆘 Still stuck? Try deleting node_modules and re-running npm install .
